options.content:
PCS testing

Monitoring of a thruster pod: propulsion, motor, drives, cooling water, hydraulics, shear beams and mounts, with the batteries and DC switches. The **Pod** selector switches every panel between FWD and AFT, except the batteries and DC switches, which serve both pods. Drives are named by their designation: FWD 13-31-U101/U102, AFT 13-11-U101/U102. **Times are UTC.** **DC power** corrected: raw × 0.1 kW, positive when consuming. **Shaft power** and **propeller speed** come from the PLC, corrected: raw / 10, in kW (negative when propelling) and rpm (without sign). **Torque** corrected: raw × 100 Nm at the motor shaft. **Pitch and azimuth** in whole degrees. **Load pins** corrected: raw / 1000 kN. **THRS** temperatures in °C and flows in l/min. **DC switch** heat sink temperature corrected: raw × 0.1 °C; currents raw. Where a published value disagrees with the unit its IO list declares, the dashboard shows the corrected value and the info icon says so. Values another device reads and acts on are shown as published: the power limits the PMS sends, the PMS's consumed power and the torque setpoints. The info icon of each panel states the source and any correction.

spec.title: Winding temperatures · ${pod:text}
spec.description: The six stator winding temperatures, U, V, W of winding sets 1 and 2, in °C as published by the PMS. The W1 column is named differently on FWD and AFT; the hidden variable picks the right one.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
  avg(windingtempu_1__value) AS "U1",
  avg(windingtempv_1__value) AS "V1",
  avg(${winding_w1}__value) AS "W1",
  avg(windingtempu_2__value) AS "U2",
  avg(windingtempv_2__value) AS "V2",
  avg(windingtempw_2__value) AS "W2"
FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_${pod}
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

spec.title: Bearing temperatures · ${pod:text}
spec.description: Motor bearing temperatures, drive end (upper) and non-drive end (lower), in °C.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
  avg(bearing_de_temp__value) AS "Drive end",
  avg(bearing_nde_temp__value) AS "Non-drive end"
FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_${pod}
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

spec.title: IGBT temperature · ${pod:text}
spec.description: IGBT temperature of each Aradex drive, in °C. Values of 199, published while the drive is off, are left out.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
  avg(CASE WHEN drive = 1 THEN NULLIF(igbt, 199) END) AS "Drive 1",
  avg(CASE WHEN drive = 2 THEN NULLIF(igbt, 199) END) AS "Drive 2"
FROM (SELECT timestamp, 1 AS drive, temp_igbt__value AS igbt FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_${pod}_ara1 WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT timestamp, 2 AS drive, temp_igbt__value AS igbt FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_${pod}_ara2 WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)) a
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

spec.title: Power stage (coldplate) temperature · ${pod:text}
spec.description: Power stage temperature of each Aradex drive, in °C. Values of 199, published while the drive is off, are left out.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
  avg(CASE WHEN drive = 1 THEN NULLIF(stage, 199) END) AS "Drive 1",
  avg(CASE WHEN drive = 2 THEN NULLIF(stage, 199) END) AS "Drive 2"
FROM (SELECT timestamp, 1 AS drive, temp_power_stage__value AS stage FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_${pod}_ara1 WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT timestamp, 2 AS drive, temp_power_stage__value AS stage FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_${pod}_ara2 WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)) a
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

spec.title: Thruster · ${pod:text}
spec.description: The pod's thruster cooling circuit: the supply temperature shared by both pods, the pod's return temperature and flow. The legend shows each sensor's technical name. THRS sensors, temperatures in °C, flows in l/min (right axis, dashed).

spec.rawSql:
SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
  technical_name,
  avg(temperature__value) AS "temperature"
FROM public.marpower__thrs__temperatures
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND yard_tag IN ('50001038-28', CASE '${pod}' WHEN 'fwd' THEN '50001038-02' ELSE '50001038-01' END)
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 2, 1

SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
  technical_name,
  avg(flow__value) AS "flow"
FROM public.marpower__thrs__flows
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND yard_tag IN (CASE '${pod}' WHEN 'fwd' THEN '50001057-22' ELSE '50001218-02' END)
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 2, 1

spec.title: Drive 1 (${pod_system}-U101)

GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 2, 1

SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,

GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 2, 1

spec.title: Drive 2 (${pod_system}-U102)
spec.description: Cooling of Aradex drive 2: the supply temperature shared by the pod's two drives, the drive's return temperature and flow. The legend shows each sensor's technical name. THRS sensors, temperatures in °C, flows in l/min (right axis, dashed).

spec.rawSql:

SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,

spec.title: Brightloops · ${pod:text}
spec.description: The battery DC/DC converters' cooling loops on the selected pod's side (FWD loops 1–2, AFT loops 1–4): supply temperature, return temperature and flow per loop. The legend shows each sensor's technical name. THRS sensors, temperatures in °C, flows in l/min (right axis, dashed).

spec.rawSql:
SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
  technical_name,
  avg(temperature__value) AS "temperature"
FROM public.marpower__thrs__temperatures
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND (yard_tag IN ('50001038-69', '50001038-13', '50001038-12') AND '${pod}' = 'fwd' OR yard_tag IN ('50001038-15', '50001038-08', '50001038-07', '50001038-06', '50001038-05') AND '${pod}' = 'aft')
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 2, 1

SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
  technical_name,
  avg(flow__value) AS "flow"
FROM public.marpower__thrs__flows
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND (yard_tag IN ('50001057-12', '50001057-11') AND '${pod}' = 'fwd' OR yard_tag IN ('50001057-07', '50001057-06', '50001057-05', '50001057-04') AND '${pod}' = 'aft')
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 2, 1

spec.title: Hydraulic oil temperature · ${pod:text}
spec.description: Hydraulic power pack tank temperature from the PLC, in °C as published.

spec.rawSql:

spec.title: Shear beams · ${pod:text}
spec.description: The four shear beams and the calculated shear beam value (dashed), as published, in the unit the IO list declares, Nm.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
  avg(shear_beam_1__value) AS "Beam 1",
  avg(shear_beam_2__value) AS "Beam 2",
  avg(shear_beam_3__value) AS "Beam 3",
  avg(shear_beam_4__value) AS "Beam 4",
  avg(shear_beam_calculated__value) AS "Calculated"
FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_${pod}
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

spec.title: Power and PMS limits · ${pod:text}
spec.description: Solid: DC power per drive, declared in kW but published in 0.1 kW: shown corrected, raw × 0.1 kW, positive when consuming. spec.rawSql:

GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
  min(CASE WHEN right(topic, 4) = 'u101' THEN setpoint_power__value END) AS "Propulsion limit d1",

WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND topic IN ('marpower/150000-propulsion-ara/' || CASE '${pod}' WHEN 'fwd' THEN '13-31-u101' ELSE '13-11-u101' END, 'marpower/150000-propulsion-ara/' || CASE '${pod}' WHEN 'fwd' THEN '13-31-u102' ELSE '13-11-u102' END)

  FROM (SELECT timestamp, 1 AS drive, speed__value AS speed, setpoint_2__value AS max_torque, setpoint_3__value AS min_torque FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_${pod}_ara1 WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
